Complete Guide to Traditional Hindu Marriage Biodata Format & Kundali Matching

A traditional Hindu marriage biodata (Vivah Parichay Patra) balances personal and professional accomplishments with Vedic astrological (Janam Patrika) and family lineage details so both families can verify Gun Milan and Gotra compatibility.

Biodata SectionEssential Fields & Cultural AttributesWhy Families Expect It
1. Auspicious Header & Emblem|| Shree Ganeshay Namah ||, || Om Namah Shivaya ||, or Kuldevi invocation with Lord Ganesha / Kalash motifSets a sacred, respectful tone at the top of the A4 matrimonial sheet
2. Vedic Horoscope (Janam Kundali)Date, Exact Time & Place of Birth, Rashi (Moon Sign), Nakshatra & Charan, Gotra, Manglik / Kuja Dosha, Gan & NadiEssential for 36-point Ashtakoot Gun Milan and Gotra exogamy verification
3. Education, Career & PackageHighest Degree, University, Designation, Organization, Work City, and Optional Annual Income (CTC)Provides clarity on professional stability and preferred work location
4. Family & Lineage (Khandan)Father's & Mother's Name/Profession, Siblings, Family Type (Joint/Nuclear), Native Place, and Maternal Uncle (Mama / Nanihal)Highlights family values, ancestral roots, and extended kinship network

Frequently Asked Questions — Hindu Marriage Biodata Format

Common questions about creating, customizing, and downloading your Hindu Marriage Biodata Format in PDF, Word (.docx), and HD PNG formats.

What astrological details are mandatory in a Hindu marriage biodata?

A complete Hindu marriage biodata should include Date of Birth, exact Time of Birth (with AM/PM), Place of Birth, Rashi (Moon Sign), Nakshatra with Charan/Pada, Gotra, and Manglik status. You can also toggle a live 12-house Vedic Kundali chart directly on the A4 sheet.

Can I add both paternal and maternal Gotra in the Hindu biodata maker?

Yes. Every field label and value is 100% customizable. You can list Self/Paternal Gotra alongside Mama Gotra (Maternal Uncle lineage) and Kuldevi/Kuldevta details.

How do I include a North Indian or South Indian Kundali chart on my biodata?

Open Tab 4 (Studio & Kundali) and check "Show Kundali Chart on Biodata". Choose North Indian Diamond, South Indian Rashi Box, or East Indian Sunburst style and edit the 12 house planetary placements.

Is the Hindu marriage biodata PDF & Word download completely free?

Yes. All 242 templates, Ganesha/Kalash emblems, Kundali charts, and 300-DPI PDF, Editable Word (.docx), and HD PNG exports are 100% free with zero watermarks.
